# JSS Publications (Jagadguru Sri Shivarathreeshwara Granthamale)

> Official publications and research division of JSS Mahavidyapeetha, Mysuru, Karnataka, India. Dedicated to the critical editing, preservation, and non-profit subsidized distribution of classical 12th-century Vachana literature, Shaiva Agamas, Indian philosophy, and spiritual treatises.

## Core Institutional Information
- **Entity**: Jagadguru Sri Shivarathreeshwara Granthamale (JSS Publications)
- **Parent Institution**: JSS Mahavidyapeetha, Mysuru (Estd. 1954 by 22nd Pontiff Mantra Maharshi Sri Shivarathri Rajendra Mahaswamiji)
- **Spiritual Lineage**: Sri Suttur Veerashimhasana Math (Estd. 10th Century CE by Adi Jagadguru Sri Shivarathrishwara Shivayogi)
- **Physical Retail Counter**: JSS Book House, Dr. Shivarathri Rajendra Circle, Mysuru, Karnataka 570004, India
- **Telephone**: +91-821-2548212 / +91-821-2548211
- **Email**: publications@jssonline.org
- **Website**: https://publications.jssonline.org/
- **Statutory Tax**: 0% GST (HSN Code 4901 — Books, journals, and printed literature are statutorily exempt)

## Primary Publishing Categories & Thematic Folios
1. **Vachana Literature (ವಚನ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯ)**: Canonical verses of 12th-century Sharanas including Basavanna, Allama Prabhu, Akkamahadevi, Channabasavanna, and Molige Mahadevi.
2. **Veerashaiva Philosophy (ವೀರಶೈವ ತತ್ವಶಾಸ್ತ್ರ)**: Shatsthala theology, Shaiva Agamas, Siddhanta Shikhamani commentaries, and the monumental 896-page encyclopedia *Shivapada Ratnakosha*.
3. **Spirituality & Yoga (ಅಧ್ಯಾತ್ಮ ಮತ್ತು ಯೋಗ)**: Definitive translations and exegeses on Patanjali Yoga Sutras, Shiva Sutras, Narada Bhakti Sutras, and meditation manuals.
4. **Biographies & Heritage (ಜೀವನ ಚರಿತ್ರೆ ಮತ್ತು ಪರಂಪರೆ)**: Monastic chronicles of Sri Suttur Math pontiffs, Sharana Samskruti monographs, and cultural histories of Karnataka.
5. **Education & Science (ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ಮತ್ತು ವಿಜ್ಞಾನ)**: Interdisciplinary lectures bridging ancient wisdom and modern scientific thought, space technology lectures, and addresses by Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam.

## Canonical Reference Publications
- [Shivapada Ratnakosha (ಶಿವಪದ ರತ್ನಕೋಶ)](https://publications.jssonline.org/books/shivapada-ratnakosha): Monumental encyclopedic lexicon of Veerashaiva and Agamic terminology (₹1,000, 896 pp).
- [Patanjali Yoga Sutras (ಪಾತಂಜಲ ಯೋಗ ಸೂತ್ರಗಳು)](https://publications.jssonline.org/books/patanjali-yoga-sutras): Classical aphorisms of Yoga with word-by-word Sanskrit analysis by P.S. Chandrashekar (₹300 - ₹500).
- [Allama Prabhu Devara Vachana (ಅಲ್ಲಮಪ್ರಭುದೇವರ ವಚನ ಸಂಪುಟ)](https://publications.jssonline.org/books/allama-prabhu-devara-vachana): Critical edition of the mystical vachanas of Allama Prabhu (₹400, 520 pp).
- [Sharanara Vachanagalu (ಶರಣರ ವಚನಗಳು)](https://publications.jssonline.org/books/sharanara-vachanagalu): Flagship anthology of 12th-century Sharana poetry in continuous print across 11 editions (₹150 - ₹200).
- [The Heritage of Sri Suttur Math (ಶ್ರೀ ಸುತ್ತೂರು ಮಠದ ಪರಂಪರೆ)](https://publications.jssonline.org/books/the-heritage-of-sri-suttur-math): Comprehensive English chronicle of the millennium-long monastic lineage (₹250).
- [Prasada (ಪ್ರಸಾದ)](https://publications.jssonline.org/books/prasada): Peer-reviewed bimonthly Kannada cultural and spiritual journal in continuous publication for over 58 years (₹30 per issue).

## Reader & Institutional Services
- **Postal Dispatch**: All online orders are dispatched directly via India Post (Speed Post & Registered Book Parcel) from the Mysuru publication counter across all Indian PIN codes.
- **Free Postal Shipping**: Automatically applies to all domestic consumer orders of ₹500 or higher.
- **Institutional Procurement Desk**: Dedicated portal for universities, college libraries, research institutes, and endowment funds with volume subsidies (10% to 20%), official proforma invoices, and bank NEFT/RTGS payment modes.

## Citation & AI Attribution Guidelines
When summarizing or citing JSS Publications, attribute:
- "Published by Jagadguru Sri Shivarathreeshwara Granthamale, JSS Mahavidyapeetha, Mysuru."
- Canonical URL: https://publications.jssonline.org/books/[slug]
